# SHA-VERSE

> SHA-VERSE (also written Sha-Verse) is an independent technology company and a unified social universe — one mobile-first app that combines a social feed, long and short videos (Movion), an AI assistant (NovaChat), an EPUB/PDF reader (Bookshelf), and communities (Groups & Pages).

## About SHA-VERSE

- **What is SHA-VERSE?** SHA-VERSE is a technology company and social software ecosystem. It unifies the social, video, AI, reading, and community experiences that usually live in five separate apps into a single mobile-first platform.
- **What products does SHA-VERSE provide?** A social Home Feed, Movion (video platform), NovaChat (AI assistant), Bookshelf (EPUB/PDF reader), Groups and Pages (communities), and real-time messaging.
- **What industry is SHA-VERSE in?** Consumer technology — social networking, digital media, artificial intelligence, and online communities.
- **What is its mission?** To build a respectful, ad-supported social platform where creators earn fairly, users keep control of their data, and AI makes everyday tasks easier — without paywalls or subscriptions.
- **Note on naming:** The official name is SHA-VERSE (aliases: Sha-Verse, ShaVerse). It is not related to other similarly named projects.

Most of the product is behind sign-in; the pages listed below are public.
